title: Local derived completeness is unchanged by a unit times a positive power
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Let $a,b$ be global sections and suppose $a=u b^e$, where $u$ is an invertible global section and $e\geq1$. For $N\in D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], local derived $(a)$-completeness and local derived $(b)$-completeness are equivalent. Here local derived $(c)$-completeness means that, on each slice over $V$, $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_V}(\mathcal O_V[1/f],N|_V)=0$ for every $f\in(c)\mathcal O(V)$; localization is sheafified sectionwise and derived internal Hom is [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. More precisely, the reflection functors $R\mathcal Hom([\mathcal O\to\mathcal O[1/a]],-)$ and $R\mathcal Hom([\mathcal O\to\mathcal O[1/b]],-)$ are naturally isomorphic in a way carrying their actual augmentation-induced units to one another. The complexes are in degrees $0,1$ and augmented to $\mathcal O[0]$ by the degree-zero identity. No regularity or Noetherian hypothesis is required.
